name: Evictions carried out
definition: Residential evictions executed by New York City marshals, by calendar year of the executed date.

latest_extra.note: Year to date; latest executed date in the data is 2026-11-12.

source.name: NYC Department of Investigation, Evictions (city marshals), NYC Open Data 6z8x-wfk4

method: Counted rows whose residential_commercial_ind is 'Residential' or 'R' (the dataset uses both codes; code counts: C=137, Commercial=11813, R=1692, Residential=123578), grouped by year of executed_date. Rows without an executed date are excluded.
caveats: Possessions and evictions carried out by marshals only; it does not count tenants who leave after a court case or under threat of eviction.
Data begin in 2017. Evictions nearly stopped in 2020-2021 under the pandemic moratoriums, so those years are not a normal baseline.
Marshals can report late, so the most recent months may rise slightly.
